Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap:
- Scope: FinTechCorp is validating vendor security posture for production access (GDPR + PCI adjacencies).
- Primary asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, vendor security questionnaire, incident response timelines and BCP/DR evidence.

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a snippet of our IR playbook to start (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_ir_playbook_snippet.pdf).
2) Please send the FinTechCorp vendor questionnaire (or a link) and we will complete and return it via your secure upload.
3) Marissa (security) will follow up with technical details (contacts, retention, encryption) and provide DR/RTO metrics.
4) We’ll schedule a 30-min follow-up for next week to walk through questionnaire answers and any outstanding procurement items.

Key points we covered on the call:
- SOC 2: Redwood is in the process of Type II audits; we can provide a Type I report plus our control description and interim evidence today.
- Incident response & notification: Redwood’s practice is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a reportable personal-data incident (GDPR-aligned). We also provide continuous incident updates and a post-incident RCA within ~30 days where applicable.
- BCP/DR: We maintain DR runbooks, RTO/RPO targets, and regular tabletop exercises; we can provide sanitized artifacts for procurement review.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_ir_playbook_snippet.pdf

Proposed follow-up: Wed 22 Jul, 10:00am PT — happy to adjust.

If you want the questionnaire completed in a specific format (XLSX vs DocuSign), send it along and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks,
Jordan

Subject: Re: Security discovery: incident response & BCP evidence (post-call recap)

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the questionnaire. Answers to your bullets below, plus links to evidence and next steps.

1) SOC 2 audit status:
- Auditor: Brightline Audit Partners (external CPA firm).
- Status: Type II fieldwork scheduled for Q4 2026; Type I completed earlier this year.
- We can provide: Type I report, control description, SOC 2 readiness summary (attached) and a signed readiness letter for procurement. Full Type II report will be available after fieldwork and audit acceptance.

2) Written confirmation of GDPR notification practice:
- Redwood policy: For incidents involving personal data where notification obligations under GDPR apply, Redwood will notify affected customers (and supervisory authorities when required) no later than 72 hours after becoming aware of a reportable personal-data breach, unless an extension is permitted under law. We will also provide interim updates and a final RCA. I’ll have legal produce a short procurement-friendly statement if you need it verbatim.

3) Incidents limited to non-personal operational data:
- For incidents that are determined not to involve personal data (e.g., model weights, anonymized telemetry), we evaluate impact and may provide customer updates at our discretion. If the incident could materially affect availability, integrity, or confidentiality of customer workloads we will notify customers per our SLA and incident severity guidelines.

4) Secure upload / questionnaire handling:
- Preferred: secure SFTP or our ShareFile intake link. We can also accept via DocuSign for attested sections. Let me know which you prefer and I’ll provide the link.

BCP/DR & evidence links:
- Shared (sanitized) evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FinTechCorp/SecurityEvidence
- SOC 2 readiness doc: https://docs.redwood.com/soc2-readiness

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_ir_playbook_snippet.pdf

Marissa and Laura have more detailed technical and legal notes — looping them in. If you want a short legal-friendly statement for procurement I can follow up with a one-paragraph declaration.

Best,
Jordan

On a related note, typical timelines we provide to customers: initial incident acknowledgement within 24 hours of detection, customer notification (where legally required) within 72 hours of confirmation, and a preliminary remediation plan within 7 days. Full RCA delivered within ~30 days for incidents with customer impact.

Hi Alex —

Adding the technical details you asked for and a couple of attachments for procurement review.

Technical summary (high level):
- IR contacts: security@redwood.com (primary), ops-incident@redwood.com (oncall) — we’ll provide a CSV of on-call roles for procurement (attached: ir-contacts.csv).
- Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted via AWS KMS (customer keys available on Dedicated/Private deployments); TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Logging & retention: Default application and audit log retention is 90 days; extended retention available via contract.
- DR: RTO target ranges 15–60 minutes for critical inference routing (depends on deployment/commit level); RPO typically under 15 minutes for stateful services where configured. Refer to attached bc-dr-runbook-summary.pdf for runbook excerpts and tabletop cadence.
- SOC 2 auditor: Brightline Audit Partners (we can provide contact/engagement letter under NDA).

Attachments: bc-dr-runbook-summary.pdf, ir-contacts.csv
